svg.aria-label: The outline-only mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist: each entry checked against an index; gap chaining after the passes (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1 (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge run, after the theme runs: removes the duplicates, searches across the search themes, writes the one review (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Planner: outline and argument map (agent); Literature strategist: the sections with no source; gap chaining after the passes (agent, only when needed); Planner: assigns what was found (agent, only when needed); Outline approval (stop).
